blast_radius: Dispatches team work items; a stall means nothing is assigned.

throughput.derivation: Sum of the integer in every 'team-dispatch: N dispatched' line. Lines carry no timestamp, so this is a lifetime total over the retained log, explicitly NOT a 24h figure.

floor.reason: no windowable history: log lines carry no timestamp, and the lifetime volume is 0 so no median exists to take 30%% of

notes: Confirm with the operator whether 0 dispatched is expected (empty queue) or a defect — the loop cannot distinguish the two and neither can capmap.
Remedy: add a UTC 'ts' per line.

verification.note: Graded on throughput, not liveness: a running loop with zero volume is DEGRADED.

what_it_does: Team dispatch loop (every 300s). Its log carries no timestamps, so the window is LIFETIME, not 24h: 500 retained runs have dispatched 0 items in total.
why_it_matters: Demonstrates the running-but-idle failure mode in its purest form: the process is loaded, healthy, and has emitted zero dispatched items on every run. Zero is an observed count, not a missing one, so it grades DEGRADED rather than UNVERIFIED.
